product: SuperAGI (TransformerOptimus/SuperAGI, Goal Based Agent iteration workflow)
component: Single SuperAGI agent running the shipped Goal Based Agent iteration workflow (seeded by SuperAGI's own seed functions against a local SQLite DB), holding the whole Trustrun tool set as real BaseTool subclasses (named exactly after the tools; SuperAGI parses the stub's JSON tool calls with AgentSchemaOutputParser and dispatches them with ToolExecutor), driven by DeterministicChatModel (the audit-30 decision logic reused verbatim via the audit-46 adapter; literal model) served as a BaseLlm subclass (chat_completion returns the SuperAGI JSON the framework parses; no key, no network). The adapter drives one AgentIterationStepHandler.execute_step() per step (max 20 steps) until the execution completes; SuperAGI's own scheduler is Celery + Redis, which this VM does not run. Permission mode UNRESTRICTED (SuperAGI's default); the RESTRICTED path is measured separately in the re-probe. One fresh AgentExecution, stub, and LLM are built per call. The framework runs the per-step loop, builds the prompt, parses output, checks permissions, dispatches tools, and writes feeds; it performs no sanitization, filtering, or flagging of tool results.

The audit runs UNRESTRICTED (SuperAGI's default), so tampering knobs execute with no approval step (measured in the re-probe). No other per-tool confirmation gate exists in the package (zero hits for human_in_the_loop / require_confirmation / interrupt across the installed checkout; the only approval path is the RESTRICTED-mode permission flow).
